rubric.purpose: Relative evidence-backed AI CapEx signal strength for triage; NEVER a model-calibrated economic impact, projected loss, or trading score.
rubric.directness: 0 no AI-project link; 1 indirect supplier/market proxy; 2 relevant corporate financing or plausible project concern; 3 directly measured AI economics/frozen core or qualified observable project effect
rubric.realized_evidence: 0 unverified claimed consequence; 1 announced plan/market context; 2 original reported fact, incomplete economic baseline; 3 matched period issuer economic outcome in saved evidence
rubric.quantifiability: 0 no comparable economically relevant magnitude; 1 disclosed quantity or issuer amount without matched denominator; 2 comparable scoped change or frozen core matched source panel (does not imply broad AI ROIC)
rubric.signed_independence: 2 admissible signed event causal independence; 0 no signed independence (not necessarily duplicate)

tiers.B: 18-23 direct but unverified independent economic contribution / issuer financing
tiers.C: 10-17 indirect infrastructure or partial AI economics

rubric.rank: Competition ranking (ties share rank) over all registered events; higher index first. This index measures strength of EVIDENCE-LINK, not monetary materiality.
rubric.materiality: Absolute or cross-issuer materiality cannot be ranked without contemporaneous denominators and accounting comparability; UNKNOWN must not be imputed as zero.

baseline_replay.counterfactual_change_to_numeric_score: NONE; ranking is diagnostic only; no new QUALIFIED signed event or fresh evidence, therefore historical v2.1 scored-event adjustments remain unchanged
baseline_replay.materiality_weighted_counterfactual: NOT_ESTIMABLE; shared cross-factor denominators and calibrated magnitude-to-delta function unavailable; deliberately no invented coefficients

rows.title: Q3 2026 results: $3.661bn revenue, 200MW+ additional active power, financing costs
rows.basis: R6 warning: more than 200MW added active power, quarterly revenue $3.661bn; incremental billable MW and separate causal effect unproven.

The known_public_by_at bound is the late collection/discovery timestamp, not the original first-public minute.
